div.div: Loaded into the graph at deploy
The GraphLoader reads the ontology and each set's data files once. It writes the graph and the catalog index.
Offered in the app, never loaded
The tabs list these photos and texts. Tab 2 ingests one when you ask.
A node's image_key names a photo here. The API reads it from the data bucket when the app shows it.
